thread:
Jordan: Heads-up 10min pattern review for the quarter. I pulled the incident clusters and highlighted top recurrence vectors + suggested owners. Posting summaries + proposed follow-ups here so we can assign and track.

SREbot: Quarterly clustering complete 0 incidents flagged between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31. Clusters: pool-exhaustion, rollout-mislabel, background-job collision, external-rate-limit, cert/rotation misses. Dashboard: https://dash.company/quarterly-incidents-2026-q1

Mei: thanks Jordan. can you drop counts per cluster? helpful for prioritization.

Jordan: sure: 
- Pool exhaustion: 7 incidents (notable around model hot-swap windows and spike hours)
- Rollout mislabel: 5 incidents (canaries mis-tagged, skip keyguard)
- Background-job collisions: 3 incidents (cron jobs overlapping causing DB connection pool exhaustion)
- External rate-limit: 3 incidents (3rd-party embedding provider throttles)
- Cert & rotation misses: 2 incidents (expired certs on infra housekeeping endpoints)

Carlos: I'll take pool-exhaustion. Proposed mitigation: bump default pool margin to 15% during scheduled model refresh OR add pre-warm run for new model containers.

Leah: I can own rollout-mislabel. Plan: add CI linter to validate rollout metadata + a post-deploy verifier that checks live routing tags. ETA 3 weeks.

Omar: background-job collisions look opsy. I propose a centralized job-scheduler that enforces jitter and concurrency limits; short term add alerts when DB connections > 75%. I can prototype.

Mei: external rate-limit: request retry/backoff + circuit breaker + quota tracker. Need product to confirm acceptable retry multiplier. @Jordan can you loop in product?

Jordan: looping in product separately. For now, suggested action items below. I'll open tickets and assign provisional owners.

Jordan: ```
- ACTION-Q1-01: Pool margin & pre-warm for model swaps. Owner: Carlos. ETA: 2026-04-20. Deliverables: autoscaler policy patch, pre-warm job, load test results.
- ACTION-Q1-02: Rollout metadata linter + live verifier. Owner: Leah. ETA: 2026-04-10. Deliverables: linter, e2e check in deploy pipeline, runbook for label fixes.
- ACTION-Q1-03: Job-scheduler + DB-concurrency alerts. Owner: Omar. ETA: 2026-05-01. Deliverables: scheduler prototype, alert thresholds, migration plan.
- ACTION-Q1-04: External-rate limit strategy. Owner: Mei. ETA: 2026-04-05. Deliverables: retry middleware, circuit breaker config, product sign-off on retry budget.
- ACTION-Q1-05: Cert rotation audit + automation. Owner: Jordan. ETA: 2026-04-01. Deliverables: rotation monitor, expired-cert alert, automation script.
```

Carlos: quick note 1: pre-warm needs a safe canary path so we don't double-allocate during live traffic. I'll include a safety flag in the prototype.

Leah: note : the linter should include tag schema (env, pool, canary) and reject PRs missing keys. Also adding a check that production traffic percentage moves monotonic in CI.

Omar: putting a sample alert rule here for DB connections: 

expr: sum(pg_stat_activity_count{db="redwood"}) > 0.8 * sum(node_db_max_connections)
for: 5m
labels: severity=page
annotations: summary="DB connection saturation likely - investigate background-job spikes"

Mei: for ACTION-Q1-04 I'll draft a retry matrix: idempotent ops = 5 retries (exp backoff), non-idempotent = 1 retry + circuit breaker. will post matrix and traffic-impact calc.

Jordan: thanks. I'm creating follow-ups now: ENG-2001 (pool-margin), ENG-2002 (rollout-linter), ENG-2003 (job-scheduler), ENG-2004 (rate-limit-mitigation), ENG-2005 (cert-rotation). Will add owners + checklists.

SREbot: Reminder: Any ACTION without an owner in 48h will be auto-assigned to oncall.

Leah: small ask  can we include a retro note in each ticket: "what allowed this to recur" so we capture systemic fixes?

Jordan: yes, good point. I'll add a template field on each ticket for "recurrence analysis".

Carlos: ETA update: starting pre-warm prototype tomorrow; will share perf numbers by Fri.

Mei: tagging product: @product-team please review ACTION-Q1-04 retry bounds and sign off so we can start testing in the integration window.

Jordan: scheduling a 30-min sync next Wed to review PRs and blockers. calendar invite to follow. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
